title: Confidentiality acknowledgement
notice: WORKFLOW TEST ONLY — this draft has not been approved by legal counsel and must be replaced before external use.
paragraphs: The recipient wishes to review confidential business, technical, product, financial and commercial information relating to UP-EYE-DAWN for the sole purpose of evaluating a potential business or investment relationship.

The recipient will keep non-public information confidential, use it only for that evaluation, and disclose it only to professional advisers or representatives who need to know it and are subject to equivalent confidentiality duties.

Confidential information does not include information that the recipient can demonstrate was already lawfully known, becomes public without breach, is received lawfully from a third party without duty of confidence, or is independently developed without use of the confidential information.
If disclosure is required by law, the recipient will, where legally permitted, provide prompt notice and disclose only what is required.
No intellectual-property licence, warranty, commitment to transact or representation about future performance is granted by access to the materials.
The retention period, governing law, venue, confidentiality term, legal entity details and authorised signatory language require counsel approval before this document is used externally.
